title: Consume pantheon-base-v0.17.6 into pantheon-ops
goal: Advance the Ops foundation consumer from pantheon-base-v0.16.1 to the published pantheon-base-v0.17.6, swap the Ops baseline onto the verified rebuilt assembly, and repair the consumer defects the swap exposes: stale css specifiers, password fields that must use the shared PasswordInput, two dead base-path files, five case-only renames, an undeclared Ops doc archive and the missing check:shared-drift root script.
dependsOn: pantheon-base v0.17.6 release (tag object 2bc79966, target commit c9bc6c0f)
blocks: ops branch and pull-request closeout to main only

in: Update foundation-release.lock.json to pantheon-base-v0.17.6: release line, version, base commit, asset name, materialization path, bundle checksum and repo.tar checksum.
Rewrite .foundation/foundation-release.lock.json as the consumer ledger with the release identity, the verified digests and the gate facts read back from GitHub.
Rebuild the Ops tree from the locked release snapshot, verify the staged tree, then swap the baseline onto it.
Declare docs/migrations/legacy-ops-business-v010x as an Ops repository overlay path.
Remove backend/modules/system/iam/tenant/tenant_switch.go and backend/pkg/database/migrations/add_oidc_fields.sql, which base no longer ships and nothing references.
Follow base's five lower-camel-case pattern renames through the git index so a Linux checkout resolves them.
Repair 31 stale ../../system/components/shared/list-page.css specifiers and 6 Input.Password fields across 4 business files.
Inject check:shared-drift into the merged root package.json so Base Compatibility Rebuild can run its drift step.
out: Any change to the pantheon-base repository, an existing tag, a published release or its assets.
Hand-copying base files into the Ops source tree instead of materializing the locked release.
Any change to business module behaviour, routes, permissions, menus or database migrations.
Promoting the four advisory Ops harness checkers to CI gates.
Deleting or closing remote branches and open Dependabot pull requests.

modify: the swapped base-owned backend and frontend tree
doNotTouch: any existing tag, release or release asset

implementationNotes: rebuild-from-base.mjs resolves the base from the lock when --base is omitted, so the swap consumes the published v0.17.6 archive rather than the local ../pantheon-base working tree; only the drift gate reads that checkout.
The v0.17.6 materialization keeps bundle/ and manifest.json inside the tgz, so the ledger records materializedLayoutMatchesPriorReleases as false instead of claiming the v0.16.1 layout.

base's pattern modules were renamed to lower camel case; on a case-insensitive filesystem a copy cannot express that, so the old-case index entries were removed before applying the staged tree, and git then records them as renames with no content change.
migrate.go is base-owned, so currentRuntimeSchemaVersion moved 20 -> 24 with the swap together with migrations up to 000030; no Ops-side version pin needed editing.

The merged root package.json injects only a fixed list of Ops scripts; check:shared-drift was absent, which is why the scheduled Base Compatibility Rebuild failed its first drift step. The merge now injects it.

This is not a schema-neutral consumption: base migrations run to 000030 (tenant_plans), the menu seed moves 租户管理 under a new 租户运营 group and five new permission codes exist, so the Ops menu contract reports 40 menus / 50 routes / 221 permissions / 52 component keys.

consumerSpecificControls: shared-drift gate exposed as a runnable root script
deferredCodeIssues: Ops business modules still create their schema through AutoMigrate instead of a consumer versioned-migration channel; no such channel exists in base
Four advisory Ops harness checkers (harness-docs link, ui-quality-gate, visual-evidence, generated-marker) stay red and are not CI gates
local cgo toolchain cannot build sqlite-backed base packages, so -race coverage stays with CI Linux

riskNodes: shared prefix of the ops tree
